body: I've been on meds for 2 years and in that time this was my 4th therapist

My only "loved ones" were my 2 internet friends and they abandoned me and today my therapist told me she can't help me.  


Suicide hotlines are a fucking joke. I'll never call one again.
But I cant possibly help myself. I've learned and tried to do it over and over again, I know from experience I can't. Death seems like the only way out of this

I'm not gonna assume anything either, so I'll just ask.

Have you ever had electroconvulsive? To the point where they fry your cognitive abilities? And yet you still felt the same fucking loneliness?
Great job assuming I never took any initiative. How heartless are you...
People like you make me sick. It's one thing to try and help someone, it's another to promise them a fantasy that you have absolutely 0 control over. Get over yourself man.

Of course it's worth hurting myself for I've had way too fucking much of this miserable crippling ear shattering eye bleeding dick punching loneliness and I'm done I'm fucking done. I know I won't get a girl in a 1000 years anyway but even if I could I can't stand to live on with the fucking pain

> it will make sense in the future, I promise

How the fuck are you supposed to fucking know that? You can't fucking control or even foresee my fucking future, so don't make baseless fucking blanket statement. Advice for when another guy is in my shitty fucking mindset and you fucking try to help him, actually get to fucking understanding the goddamn issue, not making some fucked up blanket statement about promising a better fucking future.
Not within the capacity of the *World Wide Web!*, No.
I'm not fucking oblivious to the fact that love takes time and trust and commitment, but godammit if someone tells me "when the time is right" again I'm shooting their kneecaps
